# Proof-Carrying Authority (PCA)

> An execution-authentication framework ("authF") for autonomous agents: replace the bearer token with a proof-carrying action (PCActn) verified offline against a committed plan, an attenuating capability chain, risk-scaled co-signing and a trust budget. Status: Preview.

Live docs: https://atlasauth.net/pca
Repo: https://github.com/Atlas-Authorization/pca
npm: @atlasauth/pca (core), @atlasauth/pca-agent (agent client), @atlasauth/backend (verifyPCActn, requirePCA)
